newsitem.title: USA: Transocean Offshore given extension on rig.
newsitem.headline: Transocean Offshore given extension on rig.

text.p: Amerada Hess Ltd of Britain has extended for five months a charter on a offshore drilling rig for Transocean Offshore Inc.

Transocean, an offshore oil and gas drilling company, said Wednesday that its Norwegian subsidiary, Transocean ASA, received confirmation from Amerada about the extension on the fourth-generation, semi-submersible rig called Transocean No. 8.
Transocean said the extension would eliminate an open interval in the rig's schedule that existed from about November 1, 1996 to April 1, 1997.
It said it expected to generate $17 million in revenue during that period in the British sector of the North Sea.
